capabilities: Filter the graph by tags and properties
Remove links based on relationship types
Configure and switch between multiple graph views
Export the graph view to SVG
extras: Full documentation lives in a separate wiki; desktop only, no mobile support; discloses optional network and out-of-vault file access for external images; warns of possible graph settings loss and sync bugs with renamed or deleted files.
intentEvidence: Enhance the core graph plugin of Obsidian with new features.
problem: Obsidian's core Graph view has limited customization, filtering and export options, and exposes no API for extending it.
summary: Enhancement for Obsidian's core Graph view adding node images, custom shapes, tag/property filtering, saved views, pinning and SVG export.
